justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-shaped enum with distinct variants including a payload-bearing InvalidCharacter, though the public API still uses raw u32/String rather than newtype wrappers.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningfully distinct variants, no panics or unwraps in library code, and uses checked_add to avoid overflow panics.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean narrow surface with Display, Debug, Clone, Eq derives and std::error::Error impl, but no doc comments on any public items.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, iterator collection, and derives, but the index-based while loop over a Vec<char> instead of a windowed iterator and the secondary canonicalization-by-roundtrip check are slightly non-idiomatic.
